$name: Wellx Labs V2 — component specs (T1 + T2 + T3 utilities)
$notes: Component recipes for Labs Design System V2 (rose #C42663 · Figtree + IBM Plex Mono numbers-only · DARK-FIRST elevated surfaces · 2px Lucide icons). Source of truth: Figma file Rr0XYMsa9OYmLmjxMCbiMz ('Wellx Labs Design System'), pages 'V2 · Components · 1 Atoms / 2 Molecules / 3 Organisms'. Every spec declares level + composes; assemble strictly bottom-up.

conventions.radius: sm 6 (checkbox) · md 8 (buttons, inputs, menu items) · lg 12 (cards, menus, popovers) · xl 16 (dialogs, sheets) · full (pills, avatars)
conventions.focus: 2px ring in interactive/ring (violet-400, both modes) at 2px offset; inputs use ring-colored border + 3px 16% halo. KEYBOARD/AT ONLY: rings render exclusively on :focus-visible (keyboard tab, screen-reader navigation) — never on mouse/touch click, and never removed without a replacement (validate() enforces both). The Figma Focus variants document this keyboard-focus appearance. Container-carried input focus (:focus-within treatments) is keyboard/AT-modality only — pointer focus shows the caret alone.
conventions.elevation: resting = flat (hairline borders only, shadows never) · floating (menus, popovers, toasts, tooltips) = shadow/float · overlay (dialogs, sheets) = shadow/overlay + ink/40% scrim (black/60% dark) · DARK: resting surfaces sit on the elevated card tone #18181B over the #0B0B0C canvas (border #303136) — surface + border carry grouping; still no shadows (decided 2026-09-23)
conventions.icons: Lucide, 2px absolute stroke, currentColor; 16 default · 20 topbar/icon-buttons · 24 empty states
conventions.motion: durations 100/150/200/300max · ease-out enter, ease-in exit · transform+opacity only · prefers-reduced-motion = instant
conventions.textLadder: text/foreground > text/secondary (gray-700) > text/tertiary (gray-500, 4.6:1 — minimum for readable text) > text/muted-foreground (gray-400, placeholder tier only)
conventions.typeStyles: All component text carries a Type/* style. Weight variants: text-xs-medium (table headers, Delta, chart-tooltip figures) · text-xs-semibold (Tag labels) · text-sm-medium · text-md-semibold. Documented exceptions with no style: avatar initials (10–14 Medium, glyphs) and chart axis/tick micro-type (11 Regular, owned by the Recharts wrappers).
conventions.formControls: Inputs and textareas must inherit color (color:inherit) — the UA default is black and silently breaks dark mode. Placeholders stay on the muted-foreground tier.

button.name: Button
button.summary: The workhorse action control, split into four sibling sets by emphasis. One Primary per view; Secondary for supporting actions; Ghost for toolbars and quiet utilities; Destructive only for dangerous actions (pair with a confirm Dialog).
anatomy: container: auto-layout hug×fixed-height, fill = variant token, radius button/radius, gap button/gap, padding-x button/padding-x-{size}
loader (Loading state only, replaces icon slot, label stays)
button.a11y: Label ≥4.5:1 on every fill · focus ring on :focus-visible only · min hit target 24×24 · loading keeps label (aria-busy)
dos: Destructive + confirm Dialog for irreversible actions
Loading state on the pressed button
donts: Icon-only without a label (that's an icon button)

tag.name: Tag
tag.summary: Status/category label: borderless fully-rounded tint pill, soft -surface fill + vivid -foreground text/icon (every pair ≥4.5:1). Semantic core Neutral/Success/Warning/Error/Info; expressive Teal/Magenta/Orange (revisit-later).
tag.a11y: Foreground on tint ≥4.5:1 per hue · never color-only (icon + label)
dos: Keep the icon for CVD users

avatar.name: Avatar
avatar.summary: Identity mark. Fully-round, sizes 24 (cells/chips) / 32 (nav/lists) / 40 (record headers). Initials on accent tint or icon fallback on muted; Image type lands in code with the same circle mask.
avatar.code: <Avatar size="24|32|40" src? initials? /> — falls back image → initials → icon
avatar.a11y: Carries alt/aria-label with the full name · initials aria-hidden · never the only identifier
dos: Pair with the name in lists

spinner.name: Spinner
spinner.summary: Indeterminate loading — Lucide loader rotating 1s linear in code. 16 in buttons, 20 in controls, 24 for panel loads. text/tertiary or inherits button label color.
tokens: text/tertiary (semantic; inherits parent color in buttons)
spinner.a11y: role=status + visually-hidden text · reduced-motion: rotation → opacity pulse
dos: Prefer Skeleton when incoming layout is known

skeleton.name: Skeleton
skeleton.summary: Loading placeholder mirroring incoming content. background/muted fill, 1.5s shimmer in code. Text 12h radius-sm · Circle radius-full · Rect radius-md; resize instances to match the real layout.
skeleton.a11y: aria-hidden; region carries one aria-busy · shimmer pauses under reduced-motion
dos: Match real content's shape and count
Reserve exact space so data doesn't reflow
donts: Mixing skeletons and spinners in one region

separator.name: Separator
separator.summary: The hairline — borders do all separation in this flat system. 1px border/default, stretches to its container.
dos: Between menu groups, table rows, sections

label.name: Label
label.summary: Form field label — text-sm Medium foreground, exactly 8px above its control. Optional required asterisk in form/required.
label.a11y: htmlFor/id wired — clicking focuses the control · required via aria-required, not the asterisk alone

helper-text.name: Helper text
helper-text.summary: Caption under a control, 4px below (half the label gap — HIG proximity). Default text-xs form/helper; Error swaps to form/helper-error with a 12px alert icon and replaces the default helper.
helper-text.a11y: Errors announced aria-live=polite · icon + text, never color alone
donts: Critical instructions in helper (put in label)

checkbox.name: Checkbox
checkbox.summary: Multi-select control. 16px box radius control/radius; checked/indeterminate fill control/bg-on with white 12px glyph. Label optional and clickable. Indeterminate only for parent rows of partly-selected sets.
checkbox.a11y: Native input semantics · aria-checked=mixed for indeterminate · hit target ≥24 via padding
donts: Indeterminate as a pickable third value

radio.name: Radio
radio.summary: Single choice among 2–5 visible options. 16px circle; selected = control/bg-on fill with 6px white dot. Radios only exist in groups.
radio.a11y: One tab stop per group, arrows move selection · visible group label
donts: Mixing radios and checkboxes in a group

switch.name: Switch
switch.summary: Instant on/off — applies immediately, no save step. 36×20 track radius-full, 16px white thumb; On = control/bg-on. Label states the ON meaning and never changes with state.
switch.a11y: role=switch + aria-checked · thumb slides 150ms ease-out, none under reduced-motion

input.name: Input
input.summary: Single-line text entry. 36h, radius input/radius, input/bg fill, input/border hairline; states told entirely through border + halo. Optional 16px leading/trailing icons. Compose with Label + Helper via Field.
input.code: <Input placeholder value error? disabled? iconLeft? iconRight? />
input.a11y: Visible Label always · aria-describedby + aria-invalid on error · halo meets 3:1 non-text
dos: Right input types for the right keyboard

textarea.name: Textarea
textarea.summary: Multi-line entry, min 80h, top-aligned, vertically resizable in code. Same border grammar as Input; no internal icons.
textarea.a11y: Visible label · announce remaining chars at limits

tooltip.name: Tooltip
tooltip.summary: Hover/focus hint — tooltip/bg (gray-900) pill, tooltip/fg white text-xs, radius 6, shadow/float, deliberately dark in both themes. Optional ⌘-shortcut chip. Floating tier: 100ms enter with 4px drift, instant exit, 500ms open delay.
tooltip.a11y: Shows on keyboard focus · Esc-dismissible (WCAG 1.4.13) · never essential-only content · no interactive children (Popover)
donts: Tooltips on disabled elements without a focusable wrapper

delta.name: Delta
delta.summary: KPI change chip — trend icon + signed tnum value on a soft status tint. Up/Down/Flat → success/error/neutral pairs. Direction reflects movement, not sentiment: invert in code for down-is-good metrics.
delta.a11y: Icon + sign carry direction, not color alone · aria-label includes the comparison period

kbd.name: Kbd
kbd.summary: Keyboard-key cap: 20px-min chip on kbd/bg with 1px kbd/border, radius-sm, text-2xs label on kbd/fg. Purely informative — never interactive. Combos are sibling Kbds (gap 4), one key per cap; prefer symbols (⌘ ⇧ ↵ esc) over words.
kbd.a11y: Renders <kbd>; pair with aria-keyshortcuts on the target control
dos: One Kbd per key — ⌘K is two caps
Keep beside the action it triggers
donts: Spelling words when a symbol exists

progress-bar.name: Progress bar
progress-bar.summary: Determinate 8px rail: progress/track muted, radius-full, violet progress/fill sized by value %. Fill is SCALE-constrained in Figma — stretching preserves the percentage. Always violet; status never recolors it. Indeterminate sweep is code-side.
progress-bar.a11y: role=progressbar + aria-valuenow/min/max; pair with a visible tnum % label when the number matters
dos: Pair with a text-xs tnum % label
donts: Using as a good/bad threshold meter

suggestion-chip.name: Suggestion chip
suggestion-chip.summary: AI suggestion pill (Sana grammar): chip/bg card surface, 1px chip/border, radius-full, optional 16px sparkle icon, text-sm label on chip/fg. Sits above the Prompt input; selecting inserts the text into the prompt. 2–4 chips max, verb-first labels ≤ ~4 words.
suggestion-chip.a11y: Real <button>; label is the accessible name; standard focus-visible ring
dos: Dismiss the row once a prompt is sent

thinking-indicator.name: Thinking indicator

figma.note: Figma frame still shows the retired three-dot static frame; needs a 3×3 violet-300 blocks static frame (diagonal 0.9→0.18 opacities) + text/tertiary label.

thinking-indicator.summary: AI activity signal: 3×3 grid of violet-300 #BE94F3 blocks (one value, BOTH modes; blocks 25% of size, gaps 12.5%, radius ≈5.5% of size) sweeping a continuous 3.6s linear cycle — random shimmer 0–1.2s (fixed shuffle [4,0,7,2,8,3,1,6,5], 70ms stagger, 0.5s pulse) → row sweep 1.2–2.4s → column sweep 2.4–3.6s (whole line per step, 180ms stagger, 0.6s pulse). Pulse = opacity 0.18→1→0.18, rise cubic-bezier(.35,0,.25,1), fall cubic-bezier(.45,0,.55,1) — opacity only. Beside it, the operation label: text-sm Medium (14/500) live string that changes with what the model is doing ('Thinking…', 'Reading your data…', 'Writing…'), swapping via 150ms fade + 2px rise, with a continuous neutral glow sweep via background-clip:text (250% gradient, 2s linear loop) — a lighter gray band over a text/tertiary base: light gray-300 #D6D7DB over gray-500 #71747C (4.6:1), dark gray-200 #E9EAEC over #8A8F98. Color lives in the blocks only; the label stays neutral (sanctioned background-position animation; tiny paint area, progress exemption). Violet-300 is 2.41:1 on white — blocks are decorative; meaning is always carried by the label + role=status. Standalone, no avatar or mark beside it. Replaced by content on the first streamed token. Reference build + full keyframes: docs/labs-v2-thinking-blocks.html.
thinking-indicator.a11y: role=status + sr-only mirror of the current operation; announced on label change, not per pulse; blocks and visual label are aria-hidden. Reduced motion: blocks animation:none with static diagonal frame (0.9→0.18); label loses the sweep (plain text/tertiary) but operation text still updates instantly — that change is functional.
dos: Swap for content at first token
Place where the text will appear — alone, no avatar/mark
Drive the label from the real operation; announce changes via role=status
16 inline/buttons · 20 chat (default) · 24 panel loads · 48 empty states
Loops while waiting — the progress exemption to the no-loop rule
donts: Status hues or violet-600 on blocks — violet-300, both modes
Meaning carried by blocks alone (2.41:1 on white — label/status text is the signal)
Isolated sweeps (random/rows/columns) as the resting default — cycle is the signature
Glow sweep on any other text — it belongs to this component only · never brand/status hues on the label

citation-chip.name: Citation chip
citation-chip.summary: Inline source reference for AI answers. Number type marks a citation point in assistant prose ([1] on an 18px round chip); Source type shows a 12px favicon dot + bare domain in a text-2xs pill. Rides the muted-soft→muted hover ladder; clicking opens the source, hovering may raise a Hover card. Composes into Chat message assistant turns.

props.name: label
props.notes: index digit or bare domain — no protocol, no path; one line, never wraps

citation-chip.a11y: Renders <a>; accessible name "Source 1: attio.com"; ring on :focus-visible only (keyboard/AT), never on click
dos: Cite every external claim — numbers stay in reading order
Reuse one number for repeat citations of the same source
donts: Using chips for navigation — they only reference sources
Recoloring per source — chips stay monochrome

copy-button.name: Copy button
copy-button.summary: Copy-to-clipboard toggle: 24px hit cell, 16px copy glyph on the muted tier (hover foreground + muted wash). On click it flips to State=Copied — a check on status/success-foreground — for ~2s, then reverts. Consumed by the Chat message answer footer; reuse beside IDs, code blocks and share links.
copy-button.a11y: Labelled "Copy answer"/context label; aria-live announces "Copied"; state reverts after ~2s; keyboard focus ring per policy
dos: Revert to the copy glyph after ~2s
donts: Using a toast for copy confirmation — the inline check is the feedback

menu-item.name: Menu item
menu-item.summary: Row of every menu surface. 224×32, radius menu/item-radius, transparent at rest; hover menu/item-bg-hover, danger rows hover menu/item-bg-danger-hover. Optional leading icon, trailing shortcut, trailing check (single-select menus).
dos: Danger rows last after a separator
donts: Mixed icon/no-icon rows in one group

menu.name: Menu
menu.summary: The floating panel behind Dropdown menu (trigger-anchored) AND Context menu (cursor-anchored) — one anatomy, two invocations. 240w, menu/bg, menu/border hairline, radius menu/radius, shadow/float, 8px padding, 2px row rhythm, muted group labels.
menu.a11y: Focus in on open, returns on close · Esc · typeahead
donts: Only path to an action in a context menu

tab-item.name: Tab item
tab-item.summary: Underline tab: text-sm (Medium active) + 2px tabs/indicator when active. Sits on the Tabs baseline.

tabs.name: Tabs
tabs.summary: Underline tab bar for sibling views (record sub-pages, settings). Items share a hairline baseline (tabs/border), gap 16, one Active always; indicator animates 150ms.

select.name: Select
select.summary: Single choice from 6+ options (fewer → Radio). Input-grammar trigger with chevrons-up-down; opens a Menu with a trailing check on the selected row. Open state = focus grammar.
select.a11y: Combobox pattern (aria-expanded, aria-activedescendant) · typeahead · Esc closes without change

combobox.name: Combobox
combobox.summary: Searchable select for long/user-generated lists. Panel adds an auto-focused search input over the option list; multi-select uses Checked menu items; empty filter shows a 'No results' row.
dos: Debounce remote search with a Spinner row

field.name: Field
field.summary: The canonical form unit: Label 8px above, control, Helper 4px below (HIG proximity ratios). Swap the Input for Select/Combobox/Date picker/Textarea — the wrapper grammar is identical. Error swaps input border AND helper together.

search-input.name: Search input
search-input.summary: Search entry with leading search icon. Shortcut=⌘K variant is RESERVED for the sidebar quick-actions search (where ⌘K is registered); Shortcut=None is the plain search for table toolbars and filter bars.

alert.name: Alert
alert.summary: Persistent inline banner (forms, dialogs, sections): alert/<tone>/bg soft tint, colored 16px alert/<tone>/icon, alert/title Medium + alert/body. Stays until resolved — transient feedback is Toast.
alert.a11y: role=status (info/success) or alert (warning/error) · icon+title carry meaning
dos: Directly above the content it describes

toast.name: Toast
toast.summary: Transient feedback, bottom-right stack, auto-dismiss 5s (errors persist). toast/bg + toast/border + radius toast/radius + shadow/float; tone icon; optional action as a sm Secondary button (exposed nested instance). Enter 150ms rising 8px, exit 100ms, max 3 visible.

props.name: Action
props.notes: shows a sm Secondary button; edit its Label on the nested instance (the old Action-label text prop was removed)

toast.a11y: aria-live polite (assertive errors) · pause on hover/focus · action keyboard-reachable
dos: Undo over confirm dialogs where safe
Persistent errors with a next step
donts: Critical info only in a toast

card.name: Card
card.summary: Resting-tier container: card/bg, card/border hairline, radius card/radius — no shadow, ever. Header (title text-md Semi Bold + optional overflow action); Content is a Figma slot.

kpi-tile.name: KPI tile
kpi-tile.summary: Dashboard stat card (Cal.com pattern): kpi/label secondary, display-sm tnum numeral in kpi/value, Delta chip + kpi/period context. The numeral never carries color — only the Delta does. Loading = Skeleton rect.

popover.name: Popover
popover.summary: Anchored floating container for interactive content (filters, quick forms, pickers) — everything Tooltip must never hold. popover/bg, hairline, radius popover/radius, shadow/float, 8px from trigger, flips on collision.
popover.a11y: Focus moves in/returns · Esc + outside click close · no focus trap (that's Dialog)

description-list.name: Description list
description-list.summary: Key-value fact sheet for record detail (Attio record layout): dl/term muted 120px fixed + dl/value foreground, 12px rhythm, no separators. Empty values render '—'.

empty-state.name: Empty state
empty-state.summary: Zero-data view: 40px empty/icon-bg circle with 24px empty/icon-fg Lucide, md Semi Bold title, secondary one-liner, optional Secondary+Primary pair. States the situation, never apologizes.

legend.name: Legend
legend.summary: Chart series key: 16px-gap row of items (8px dot + text-xs secondary label), top-right of the Chart container. Items toggle series (aria-pressed); toggled-off series drop to 40% in code.

chart-tooltip.name: Chart tooltip
chart-tooltip.summary: Chart hover card: 12px Medium date header, then per-series rows of color dot · xs secondary label · 12px Medium tnum value. popover/bg + border, radius-md, shadow/float; follows cursor at 8px, no animation. Rendered by the Recharts wrapper.

avatar-group.name: Avatar group
avatar-group.summary: Stacked collaborators: up to 3 × 24px avatars overlapping −6px with a 2px canvas ring + '+N' overflow chip (avatar/bg-muted). Click opens the full list; hover shows names via Tooltip.

calendar-day.name: Calendar day
calendar-day.summary: One day cell, 32×32 radius-md. Selected = calendar/day-selected-bg; Today = calendar/day-today-fg Medium; Outside month = calendar/day-muted-fg; range mode adds a muted-soft band in code.

calendar.name: Calendar
calendar.summary: The Date picker popover panel: chevron month nav + text-sm Medium title, 11px Medium weekday row, 7×5 grid of Calendar day cells (4px gaps). popover tokens + shadow/float. Range mode renders two months.

date-picker.name: Date picker
date-picker.summary: Date entry: input-grammar trigger with a leading calendar icon opening the Calendar popover. Typing is always possible; min/max disable impossible dates.
date-picker.code: <DatePicker value range? min? max? format="MMM D, YYYY" />
date-picker.a11y: Grid keyboard nav (arrows/PgUp/PgDn) · typed entry always possible
dos: Let users type as well as pick

number-input.name: Number input
number-input.summary: Numeric field on the exact Input recipe (36px shell, input/* state grammar incl. the 3px 16% focus halo) plus a right stepper column: two 24×18 chevron cells over a hairline. Values text-sm tnum; ↑↓ steps, ⇧ steps 10×. Shell clips content except the Focus variant (halo must render). Wrap in Field.
number-input.a11y: Native input[type=number] semantics; steppers aria-hidden (keyboard already steps)

tag-input.name: Tag input
tag-input.summary: Multi-value field: committed values render as neutral Tag pills inside the Input shell; Enter/comma commits, Backspace removes the last, each pill gets a ✕ remove affordance in code. Pills stay neutral gray inside the field — color=meaning lives in tables. For fixed vocabularies prefer Combobox multi-select.
tag-input.a11y: Chips are buttons labelled 'remove {tag}'; count announced via aria-describedby
dos: Wrap the field taller on overflow

file-upload.name: File upload
file-upload.summary: Dropzone: dashed (5-5) upload/border on upload/bg, radius-lg, centered 40px icon tile (bound upload/bg) + 'Click to upload' (upload/link-fg) 'or drag and drop' + constraints line (text-xs). Dragover flips border to upload/border-active violet + muted wash; Error swaps border and the helper message. One click target wrapping a native file input; File upload items stack below with 8px gap.
file-upload.a11y: Labelled button + input[type=file]; drag state via aria-live; errors inline, not toasts
dos: State formats + size cap up front

file-upload-item.name: File upload item
file-upload-item.summary: Per-file row under the dropzone: 32px muted file tile, text-sm-medium name, then a live Progress bar + tnum % while Uploading, or size + 'Uploaded' + green check when Complete. Trailing ✕ cancels / removes.
file-upload-item.a11y: Row names file + % in text; remove button labelled per file
dos: One row per file, 8px stack gap

breadcrumbs.name: Breadcrumbs
breadcrumbs.summary: Topbar path trail: optional home icon, 14px chevron-right separators on breadcrumb/separator-fg, parent crumbs text-sm on breadcrumb/item-fg (hover → foreground + underline), current page text-sm-medium on breadcrumb/current-fg — text, never a link. >3 levels collapses middle crumbs to an ellipsis menu.
breadcrumbs.a11y: nav aria-label=Breadcrumb + ol; separators aria-hidden; current gets aria-current=page

pagination-item.name: Pagination item
pagination-item.summary: 32px square page cell, radius-md: text-sm on pagination/item-fg; Active = pagination/active-bg muted fill + text-sm-medium on pagination/active-fg. Hover shows the fill without the weight (code). Consumed by Pagination.

pagination.name: Pagination
pagination.summary: Table-footer pager: Previous/Next as sm Ghost buttons at the edges (disabled at range ends), page cells centered showing first 3 + last 3 with a non-interactive … between. Right-aligned under full-bleed tables beside the count summary. ←/→ move focus, Enter activates.
pagination.a11y: nav aria-label=Pagination; ellipsis is never a button
dos: Count summary left of the pager

accordion-item.name: Accordion item
accordion-item.summary: Disclosure row: full-width trigger (text-sm-medium on accordion/trigger-fg, 12px vertical padding) + 16px chevron on accordion/icon rotating 180° over 150ms, body text-sm on accordion/body-fg, 1px accordion/border under every row. Hover tints the trigger background/muted (code).

accordion.name: Accordion
accordion.summary: Disclosure stack for FAQs, advanced settings, long detail panes: items flush with their own hairlines, no outer card, no zebra. Single-open by default (type=single collapsible); multi-open is a code flag. Height animation respects prefers-reduced-motion.
dos: Short bodies; link out for policy text
donts: Auto-opening more than the first row

list-item.name: List item
list-item.summary: Generic vertical-list row (inboxes, member lists, notification panes — where Table is too heavy): optional 24px Avatar, title text-sm-medium on list/title-fg over supporting text-xs on list/meta-fg, trailing time/meta right-aligned. Hover/Selected wash list/bg-hover, radius-md, 8×12 padding; rows stack flush with no separators.
list-item.a11y: Whole row one focusable control; selected uses aria-selected; keyboard focus adds a 2px inset ring
dos: Truncate the title, never the trailing meta
donts: Per-row action buttons (use a trailing … menu)
Mixing avatar and icon rows in one list

step-item.name: Step item
step-item.summary: Wizard step: 24px radius-full dot + text-sm label. Todo = stepper/todo-bg muted dot, tertiary number + label; Active = violet stepper/active-bg dot, white number, text-sm-medium foreground label; Done = violet dot with 12px check, secondary label. Consumed by Stepper.
step-item.a11y: aria-current=step on Active; Done steps are links, Todo disabled text

stepper.name: Stepper
stepper.summary: Horizontal wizard rail: Step items joined by 48×2 connectors — stepper/connector-done violet behind completed steps, stepper/connector muted ahead. Exactly one Active; Done steps navigate back on click, Todo steps inert. 3–5 steps; more (or long labels) → vertical variant (code-side). Tops Dialog flows and full-page setup.
donts: Marking Done before data is saved

prompt-input.name: Prompt input
prompt-input.summary: FLUID WIDTH — the composer fills its thread column (canonical 640px; column min 480 / max 768, centered in the content area); never render it as a fixed narrow bar on wide viewports. AI composer: Conductor-height radius-xl shell (min-height 140 — text at top, toolbar pinned to the bottom) on prompt/bg + prompt/border; the field grows with input to max-height 280, then the text SCROLLS inside (State=Long shows the cap + thin scrollbar thumb; the toolbar never moves) — left: PLUS (composer actions menu; never add more toolbar icons) then the MODEL PICKER (model prop: text-xs-medium label + chevron-down, opens a Menu of models) then the capability pill; right: MIC (voice input) beside the 28px radius-full send on button/primary/bg. The capability boolean shows an engaged-capability pill after the mic (tag/info tint, 12 Semi Bold label + dismiss X) — picked from the plus menu, one capability at a time, X disengages. Send idles at 40% opacity until text exists; swaps to a stop square while streaming. State=Recording (after the mic): red live dot + tnum timer + a full-width waveform replace the text area — 3px bars on a 4px gap (7px rhythm), bar count derived from width; bars animate from live input (the Figma Waveform part loops three smart-animate keyframes so prototypes move too); reduced-motion shows static level bars. Toolbar becomes cancel X (discard; esc too) and the send circle a confirm check. Confirm passes through a brief State=Transcribing — Thinking dots + Transcribing… on the placeholder tier, toolbar restored, send idle — then the text lands in State=Filled, editable, never auto-sent. Recording start/stop announced via aria-live. State=Command: typing "/" summons the skills & commands menu above the field — menu/* panel of Menu items with /slash shortcuts, filtered as you type; up/down navigate, enter runs, esc closes — the shell keeps its resting border while the menu is open (no focus stroke; rings are keyboard-only). State=Models: the model picker dropdown — a 240px Menu floating OVER the field (shadow/float separates it), bottom edge just above the picker trigger (Auto checked default, exactly one checked row); selecting updates the model label. Enter sends, Shift+Enter breaks. Attachments flow INLINE WITH THE PROMPT (Conductor grammar): linear Attachment chips sit inside the wrapping text region, mid-sentence between text runs, inserted at the caret via the plus menu or drag-in; chips wrap with the sentence. The attachments boolean reveals leading chips in Default/Focus; State=Attachments shows the interleaved specimen. Attachments are added via the plus menu or drag-in; an attachment alone makes send active. Suggestion chips sit above. UPDATES 2026-09-23: resting border rides gray-300 (prompt/border); Focus is a solid violet-400 edge (1px border + 3px full-opacity halo — no 16% tint), shown under keyboard/AT modality only. VOICE: the mic starts Recording — the shell swaps to a pulsing red dot + tnum timer + animated waveform with ✕ cancel (left) and a radius-full violet ✓ confirm replacing send (right); confirm runs Transcribing — thinking blocks + "Transcribing…" in the text slot — then the transcript lands in the composer for review; send never auto-fires. Esc cancels recording.

props.name: attachments
props.notes: inline chips in the text region (leading in empty states); an attachment alone activates send

props.name: capability
props.notes: engaged-capability pill in the toolbar; one at a time; X disengages

props.name: model
props.notes: model picker beside the plus — opens a Menu of models

prompt-input.a11y: textarea labelled 'Message assistant'; send announces disabled; ⌘↵ alternate send · recording announced via aria-live (Recording started / stopped); timer readable as elapsed time
dos: Show attachments as chips inside the shell, removable per item
New composer features go in the plus menu
donts: More than the one violet accent (send)

attachment-card.name: Attachment card
attachment-card.summary: Linear attachment chip (Conductor grammar): one-line pill at TEXT SCALE (≈23px tall, 2×6 padding — sits on the prompt line, center-aligned with the text runs) — 14px colored type glyph (unclipped: the absolute 1.5 Lucide stroke needs breathing room, container never clips) (Document = red file-text via attachment/tile-doc, Image = green image glyph; glyph color follows file type in code), filename at text-sm (matches the prompt text) truncating, inline 12px ✕ remove on the tertiary tier. White chip (attachment/bg → background/card) with a 1px attachment/border hairline, radius-md (attachment/radius re-pointed). Flows inline in rows or within message text. Labels default to UNIVERSAL type names (File · Image) — real filenames per use via the prop. State=Hover: SAME FOOTPRINT as Default (the chip never reflows the sentence) — the chip takes the muted wash and the preview card (shadow/float, radius-lg) floats absolutely above it, outside the layout flow — placeholder glyph in Figma, the real thumbnail / first page in production; opens after ~400ms hover and on keyboard focus. Consumed by Prompt input (inline with the text); reusable in Chat message.

props.name: file name
props.notes: UNIVERSAL type name by default (File · Image); set the real filename per use

attachment-card.a11y: Card names file + kind; remove button labelled 'remove {file}'; keyboard-reachable
dos: Truncate long names in the middle where possible
donts: Cards outside the composer/message context (use File upload item in forms)

slider.name: Slider
slider.summary: Continuous value selection on a horizontal track — Single value or Range pair. 4px radius-full rail on slider/track-bg; filled span on slider/range-bg (primary violet); 16px bordered disc thumbs on slider/thumb-bg. Hover darkens the thumb border; Focus draws the 2px focus/ring geometry around the active thumb; Disabled is 50% opacity. Optional value-label bubbles reuse tooltip/bg·fg and show while dragging. Track stretches with width; range and thumbs scale proportionally.
slider.code: <Slider value={60} min={0} max={100} step={5}/> · <Slider range value={[20,60]}/>

props.name: Value label
props.notes: tooltip-style current-value bubbles above thumbs; show while dragging in code

slider.a11y: role=slider per thumb; arrow keys step, Home/End jump; aria-valuetext carries units; ring on :focus-visible only (keyboard/AT) — never on pointer drag or click
dos: Step in units users think in (5%, 1 day, 100 AED)
Show the value label while dragging
Keep min/max captions outside the track (text-xs tertiary)
Wrap in Field for label + helper
donts: Precise data entry — that's Number input
Recoloring the range per status — it stays primary
Vertical sliders — not in the system

otp-input.name: OTP input
otp-input.summary: One-time passcode entry — one digit per 36px cell (radius-md, input-family border), auto-advance on type, paste distributes. Digits are text-md with tnum. Six cells default, four for SMS short codes; gap is otp/gap (space-2). Focus gives the active cell input/border-focus + the 3px focus/ring halo at 16% (geometry; clipsContent stays false only on Focus variants). Error borders every cell in otp/cell-border-error and clears on the next keystroke; Disabled sits on otp/cell-bg-disabled while verifying.
otp-input.a11y: autocomplete=one-time-code on the group; inputmode=numeric per cell; announced “digit N of 6”; errors via aria-live; border+halo on :focus-visible (native input behavior — typing context keeps it visible after click, per system rule)
dos: Auto-submit when the last digit lands
Distribute a pasted code across cells
Clear the error state on the next keystroke
Wrap in Field for label + helper
donts: Masking digits — codes are short-lived, visibility beats secrecy
More than 6 cells — longer codes get a plain Input

hover-card.name: Hover card
hover-card.summary: Entity preview raised after ~500ms hover on links, chips, table cells and citation chips — the Attio-style record peek. 320px, padding 16, hovercard/radius (lg), hovercard/bg (popover) with hairline hovercard/border and shadow/float (always paired). Header: 40px avatar (Person = round on avatar/bg; Company = radius-sm primary mark) + text-sm-medium name + text-xs meta line; hairline separator; up to three 16px-icon + text-xs meta rows. Preview only — click goes to the entity; dismisses on mouse-out/Esc.
hover-card.a11y: Pointer-only enhancement — the anchor link stays the keyboard path; card is aria-hidden, never focus-trapped; closes on Esc and mouse-out
dos: Open after ~500ms — never on accidental pass-through
Keep to three meta rows; the record page holds the rest
Let click go to the entity
donts: Buttons or actions inside — previews only
Nesting hover cards from links inside a card
Making it the only path to info — touch has no hover

page-banner.name: Page banner
page-banner.summary: Full-width announcement strip pinned above the page header — the page-level sibling of the inline Alert. Edge to edge, radius 0, padding 16/10, 40px min height. Tone pairs banner/<tone>-bg + banner/<tone>-fg map to the status surface/foreground trios; Brand uses the interactive/accent pair (same as sidebar-active). 16px tone icon (info / check-circle / alert-triangle / alert-circle / sparkle), text-sm message fills, optional underlined text-sm-medium action link, optional 16px dismiss ✕. One banner max per page; highest severity wins.

props.name: Action
props.notes: underlined action link in the tone foreground

props.name: Dismissible
props.notes: dismiss ✕; Error banners are not dismissible in product use

page-banner.a11y: role=status (info · success · brand) or role=alert (warning · error); dismiss is a labeled icon button and action a real link — both show the ring on :focus-visible only (keyboard/AT)
dos: Keep the message to one line where possible
Pair every Error banner with a next step
Persist dismissal — never re-show on reload
donts: Form validation — that's Alert and field errors
Feature announcements in Error or Warning tones

filter-chip.name: Filter chip
filter-chip.summary: Per-field table filter trigger — one chip per filterable column, full-round, 36h, hairline border on card. States: Default ('Status' + chevron-down 16) · Hover (muted bg) · Open (1.5px ring-colored border while its dropdown is up) · Applied ('Status:' muted + value SemiBold foreground + chevron) · Applied hover (chevron swaps for the clear ×) · Add filter (dashed border, plus icon, muted — opens the field picker).
filter-chip.a11y: Button semantics; aria-expanded while its dropdown is open; the clear × is its own labelled button
dos: Value in SemiBold, field name muted
Open state ring while the dropdown is visible
donts: A single generic 'Filter' builder chip (superseded pattern)

filter-options-dropdown.name: Filter options dropdown
filter-options-dropdown.summary: The dropdown owned by ONE filter chip: a checkbox multi-select of that field's values (real Checkbox instances with label text), hairline divider, muted 'Clear filter' row. 220w, popover background, hairline border, shadow/float, radius 12. Option rows 32h, radius 6, hover muted wash.
filter-options-dropdown.a11y: menu/listbox semantics with aria-multiselectable; checkbox options; Clear filter is a menuitem
dos: Clear filter always last, below the divider
donts: Field/operator/value builder rows (that's a different, superseded pattern)
Resting shadows — this is the floating tier

filter-bar.name: Filter bar
filter-bar.summary: Chips-on-top-of-table pattern: one Applied/Default chip per active field + the dashed Add-filter chip, 8px gaps, left-aligned above the table-card. Each chip opens its own Filter options dropdown.
donts: Hiding applied filters behind a single count

dialog.name: Dialog
dialog.summary: Centered modal for focused decisions: 480w (640 max), radius dialog/radius (xl), dialog/bg, shadow/overlay on ink/40% scrim (black/60% dark). Header title+subtitle+X; Content slot; right-aligned footer (Secondary Cancel + confirm). Destructive variant embeds a warning Alert and confirms with Button/Destructive — never default-focused.
dialog.a11y: Focus trapped + returned · Esc/scrim close (blocked in destructive) · initial focus on Cancel in destructive · aria-labelledby

sheet.name: Sheet
sheet.summary: Side panel from the right edge (left in RTL): 400w (480 max), full height, sheet/border hairline left, shadow/overlay, radius sheet/radius (xl) on the detached corners only. Header/footer hairline-separated; Content slot scrolls. Keeps list context visible.

table-header-cell.name: Table header cell
table-header-cell.summary: Sticky header cell: 36h, 12px Medium table/header-fg label with a leading column-type icon (Attio pattern) and optional sort indicator (aria-sort button in code).

table-cell.name: Table cell
table-cell.summary: Body cell, 40h comfortable (36 compact / 48 relaxed). Types: Text · Entity (24px avatar + name) · Tag · Numeral (right-aligned tnum) · Link (underlined table/link) · Muted ('—') · Checkbox (48w selection column).

table-toolbar.name: Table toolbar
table-toolbar.summary: Control strip above the table-card. Since 2026-10-20 the default Table context shows ONLY the filter bar (chips-on-top pattern), left-aligned; search, Sort and the primary action are slots that other contexts may reveal. 52h, transparent.

table.name: Table
table.summary: THE FLAGSHIP, Maze-style since 2026-10-20: the data region (header + rows + footer) lives in a rounded 'table-card' — radius 10, hairline border, card background, content clipped — with the filter bar above it. Header: 42h muted-gray band, UPPERCASE labels at +6% tracking, a 16px arrow-up-down sort icon per column, transparent header cells so the band reads continuously. Rows: 56h default (airy), hairline dividers only — no zebra. Checkbox selection column. Status cells may render as PLAIN COLORED TEXT (status/*-foreground) instead of tag pills. All numerals in IBM Plex Mono, right-aligned. Footer: quiet pagination — 'Showing 1 – N · Page X'. Row states in code: hover muted-soft wash, selected accent tint, loading skeleton rows, empty = Empty state spanning the body.

density.rule: 56 is the default (Maze-style airy); 40/36 are the comfortable/compact modes. Density is a system-wide mode, never per screen.

table.a11y: Real <table> semantics · sortable headers are buttons with aria-sort · selection announced
dos: Wrap header+rows+footer in the rounded, clipped table-card (radius 10 + hairline + card bg)
Right-align numerals in IBM Plex Mono, left-align the rest
UPPERCASE +6% tracked header labels with the sort icon
donts: Tag pills AND colored text mixed in one status column — pick one per table
Semantic per-column header icons (replaced by the sort glyph)

sidebar-item.name: Sidebar item
sidebar-item.summary: Nav row: 232×32, radius sidebar/item-radius, 16px icon + text-sm label + optional count. Active = sidebar/item-bg-active (interactive/accent, violet-50 tint) with Medium sidebar/item-fg-active (accent-foreground, violet-800) label + icon; hover = sidebar/item-bg-hover (muted-soft). The accent belongs to the single active item only — hover and rest stay gray. Layout=Collapsed: 40×32 icon-only cell for the 64px rail — label moves to a tooltip, count becomes a status dot (both code-side); state washes unchanged.

sidebar-group-label.name: Sidebar group label
sidebar-group-label.summary: Collapsible section header — text-xs sidebar/group-label with chevron. Groups sit 24px apart.

workspace-switcher.name: Workspace switcher
workspace-switcher.summary: Sidebar header row: 24px workspace mark + name + trailing slot. Logo=Round (avatar) / Square (radius-sm brand tile) show chevrons-up-down and open the workspace menu; Logo=Avatar-collapse / Logo-collapse (user-added) swap the trailing icon for the 16px sidebar collapse toggle — the Sidebar defaults to Avatar-collapse, the workspace menu opens from the row itself, and the collapse icon takes the rail to the 64px icon-only state (code-side). Collapsed-avatar / Collapsed-logo: 40×40 rail twins — centered mark only; the mark opens the workspace menu.

sidebar-footer.name: Sidebar footer
sidebar-footer.summary: Sidebar user row: 24px Avatar + name text-sm-medium / email text-xs + trailing 16px ellipsis. The whole row is a menu trigger — profile, preferences, sign out AND Settings expand from here (Settings left the nav rail). Never a bare gear icon.

sidebar.name: Sidebar
sidebar.summary: The 256px PURE WHITE app sidebar (locked override on the Attio shell), sidebar/border hairline right. Top-down: workspace switcher, ⌘K Search (Shortcut=⌘K — the only place it appears), nav items at 4px rhythm, collapsible groups 24px apart, flex space, settings + user footer. One Active item always, matching the route (aria-current=page). Bottom of the rail: a “Powered by” credit — text-2xs beside the official Wellx Labs lockup inline at 80×16 (the served PNG via get_logo, never redrawn or retypeset), centered in a single 36px row — then the user footer row. The switcher rides its Avatar-collapse variant — trailing sidebar icon = collapse toggle (64px icon-only rail, code-side); workspace menu opens from the row itself. State=Collapsed (drawable): 64px icon-only rail — expand toggle at the TOP (replaces the workspace mark), search icon button in the search slot (opens ⌘K), Layout=Collapsed items, footer avatar (account + workspace menus).
donts: Extending the accent beyond the one active item (hover/rest stay gray)

app-shell.name: App shell
app-shell.summary: Template root every product screen lives in: 256 Sidebar + 56h topbar (text-sm secondary breadcrumb left, ≤3 utility 20px icons right, hairline bottom) + Content with 24px gutters (32 wide; tables full-bleed). Entirely flat. Deliberately bound to SEMANTIC tokens (template chrome, not a themeable component).
app-shell.a11y: nav/header/main landmarks · skip-to-content first in tab order
donts: Page titles in the topbar (they belong to content, display-xs)

chart-container.name: Chart container
chart-container.summary: The chart card: card tokens, radius-lg, flat. Header = md Semi Bold title + Legend top-right; the chart slot is FILL-width so hosted charts stretch. Swap bodies per use: Line · Bar · Pie (donut) · Radar · Area · Sparkline. Loading = Skeleton rect; empty = Empty state; error = inline Alert.

line-chart.name: Line chart
line-chart.summary: RESPONSIVE body (stretches to its card): 2px rounded series strokes (chart/series-1/2), horizontal dotted chart/grid gridlines only, unboxed axes with 11px chart/axis labels in a space-between row. Stretch is horizontal-only — same contract as the responsive Recharts wrapper.
donts: Boxed plot areas or vertical gridlines

bar-chart.name: Bar chart
bar-chart.summary: RESPONSIVE grouped bars: 20w bars, 3px top radius, chart/series-1/2 pairs in a bottom-aligned space-between row (gaps grow with width), dotted gridlines.

pie-chart.name: Pie chart
pie-chart.summary: Untitled UI-style donut: 58% inner radius, contiguous slices (no gaps), largest first from 12 o'clock, right-side dot legend. MONOCHROME ordered ramp chart/mono-1..6 (violet 600→100); fewer slices pick spaced steps for contrast. Fixed aspect — instances center, never stretch.
donts: Multicolor slices — the donut ramp is monochrome violet
Solid pie in Figma (innerRadius is a code parameter)

radar-chart.name: Radar chart
radar-chart.summary: Untitled UI-style radar, 1–3 series on a whisper-light chart/grid-soft heptagon (fainter than line/bar gridlines) with muted value-tick pill chips up the top axis and secondary day labels. Series 1 = chart/mono-1 stroke over chart/mono-5 fill (55% solo / 30% overlaid); Series 2 = chart/accent-pink, Series 3 = chart/accent-blue, both 16% fills. Fixed aspect — center, never stretch.

sparkline.name: Sparkline
sparkline.summary: Inline trend miniature: 96×32, one 2px rounded polyline on chart/mono-1 violet — no axes, gridlines or dots. SCALE constraints preserve the shape when stretched. Lives in KPI tiles and table cells for 30-day movement; color never changes per trend — the Delta chip carries good/bad. Production surface: coded Recharts wrapper.
sparkline.a11y: aria-hidden decoration beside the real numbers (KPI value + Delta)

area-chart.name: Area chart
area-chart.summary: Volume twin of the Line chart: identical responsive grid grammar (dotted chart/grid hairlines, unboxed axes, 11px Regular axis labels (chart-grammar exception — lighter than text-2xs Medium; owned by the Recharts wrapper in production), STRETCH gridlines + SCALE series) with each 2px series stroke over a 12% same-hue closed area fill (chart/series-1/2). Use when filled magnitude matters (revenue volume, cumulative signups); >2-series stacking is code-side. Hosted by Chart container. Production surface: coded Recharts wrapper.
area-chart.a11y: Charts pair with a data table or summary for screen readers (dataviz audit pending)

command-palette.name: Command palette
command-palette.summary: The ⌘K surface: 560px overlay at 20vh over the ink scrim — command/bg, radius-xl, 1px command/border, shadow/overlay. Search row (16px icon + text-sm query + esc Kbd, hairline below) · grouped Menu-item results under text-2xs command/section-fg labels (Navigation · Actions · Records, ~7 rows then scroll, first row pre-selected) · footer Kbd hints (↑↓ · ↵ · esc, hairline above). Fuzzy-matches commands, navigation and records. Opened from the sidebar search or ⌘K anywhere.
command-palette.a11y: cmdk combobox: focus trap, aria-activedescendant on ↑↓, results aria-live, esc returns focus to the trigger
dos: Groups by frequency: Navigation, Actions, Records
donts: More than ~7 visible rows before scroll
Palette as the only path to a feature

timeline-item.name: Timeline item
timeline-item.summary: One activity event: 24px marker (Avatar for people · timeline/dot-bg circle + 12px icon for system events · 8px dot for minor ones) over a 2px timeline/line connector that stretches to the next marker (hidden on the last item), beside actor (text-sm-medium on timeline/title-fg) + action (text-sm on timeline/body-fg) + time (text-xs on timeline/time-fg). Consumed by Activity feed.
timeline-item.a11y: Reads as a sentence; full datetime in aria-label

activity-feed.name: Activity feed
activity-feed.summary: Chronological event stream for record-detail panes and audit views: Timeline items stacked flush (their bottom padding sets the rhythm), newest first, connector hidden on the last item. Past ~10 items group under sticky day headers and lazy-load (code-side). Markers by event kind, never decoration.
dos: Write events as sentences (who did what)

chat-message.name: Chat message
chat-message.summary: One conversation turn (Sana grammar): User = right-aligned chat/user-bg bubble, radius-lg, 14×10 padding, max 320px; Assistant = NO bubble, NO mark or avatar (mark removed 2026-09-23) — fill-width plain text-sm on chat/assistant-fg + text-xs source/time meta on chat/meta-fg; Thinking = Thinking indicator alone while streaming — no mark, no avatar; blocks + operation label sit where the response text will appear. Consumed by Chat thread. UPDATES 2026-09-23: every assistant answer carries a message-actions row — copy (icon flips to a green check ~1.6s on success), thumbs up/down as a mutually exclusive aria-pressed pair, regenerate (re-runs the same question) — with a sources cluster right-aligned: overlapping 20px chips + "N sources · HH:MM" in text-xs tertiary.

props.name: sources
props.notes: source-icon stack + "N sources · time"; hide when the answer used no sources

chat-message.a11y: Turns are articles; role identified in the accessible name · action icons are labelled buttons (Copy answer, Good answer, Bad answer, Regenerate); feedback state announced

chat-thread.name: Chat thread
chat-thread.summary: The conversation surface: Chat messages stacked with 20px gaps on the plain canvas — no thread card, no alternating tints, a centered column — min 480, max 768 on wide viewports; the Prompt input fills the same column. While streaming the last turn is Role=Thinking, replaced as tokens arrive. Agent runs render inline as Agent activity cards between turns. Prompt input docks below; Suggestion chips above it on empty threads. Auto-scroll pins to newest unless the user scrolled up.
chat-thread.a11y: role=log aria-live=polite; new assistant turns announced
dos: Assistant turns unboxed — bubbles are user-only
Sources under answers that used them
donts: Letting the column exceed 768px — readability caps the measure
Violet assistant text (accent lives in the mark)

agent-activity-card.name: Agent activity card
agent-activity-card.summary: Inline agent-run record (Zapier Central grammar): agent/bg card, 1px agent/border, radius-lg — 28px zap tile on agent/icon-bg, run title (text-sm-medium, verb-first outcome) + timing (text-xs agent/meta-fg), live status corner (Thinking indicator (blocks, 16) Running · green check-circle Complete · red alert-circle Failed), then per-step rows (14px check/loader/x-circle + text-xs) that stream in. Failed shows the failing step verbatim + a sm Ghost 'Retry run'. Renders in Chat threads and activity panes; completed cards are immutable — reruns create new cards.
agent-activity-card.a11y: aria-busy while Running; status changes aria-live; steps are an ordered list; Retry is a real button
donts: Non-agent events in this card (use Activity feed)

chat-history-item.name: Chat history item
chat-history-item.summary: One previous-conversation row: 232×32, radius-md — text-sm title on history/title-fg truncating to one line, relative time text-xs on history/time-fg. Hover swaps the time for a 16px ellipsis menu (rename · pin · delete, a Menu instance) over the history/bg-hover wash; Active = the open chat: wash + text-sm-medium on history/title-active-fg, time visible. One Active max. Consumed by Chat history.
chat-history-item.a11y: Row is a link; active aria-current=page; row menu reachable by keyboard focus, not hover-only

chat-history.name: Chat history
chat-history.summary: 'Previous chats' panel of the Assistant surface: a FLAT list of conversation rows, newest first, 2px gaps, no group headers and no topic folders (deliberate user decision). Sized for the 256px sidebar (232 inner); also lives in a Popover or Sheet on smaller shells. A 'New chat' Secondary button (or ⌘K) sits above; rows past ~30 lazy-load; delete confirms via the destructive Dialog. Chats auto-name from the first prompt, renameable.
chat-history.a11y: nav aria-label='Chat history'; times carry full datetime in aria-label
dos: Confirm deletes with the destructive Dialog
donts: Group headers or topic folders — flat list only
